# Alert

> Inline status panel for callouts, errors, and notices.

Status: beta.

This file matches the installed `alert` source. The online docs follow the latest release and may describe a newer version.

## Install

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add https://control-ui.dev/r/alert.json
```

With `@ctrl-ui/react` instead of the registry, import from `@ctrl-ui/react/` where this file says `@/components/control-ui/`; this file then lives at `node_modules/@ctrl-ui/react/dist/docs/alert.md`.

## npm dependencies

- `@base-ui/react@^1.9.0`

## Registry dependencies

- `core`

## Exports

- `@/components/control-ui/knob-contracts/alert-knobs`: `alertKnobs`, types `AlertKnobStyle`
- `@/components/control-ui/ui/alert`: `alertTones`, `Alert`, `AlertTitle`, `AlertDescription`, `AlertAction`, types `AlertTone`, `AlertProps`, `AlertTitleProps`, `AlertDescriptionProps`, `AlertActionProps`

## Composition

### Anatomy

```tsx
<Alert>
  <AlertTitle />
  <AlertDescription />
</Alert>
```

### Dismissible

AlertAction takes its own column beside the title, so long text wraps before a dismiss button instead of running under it.

```tsx
<Alert>
  <AlertTitle />
  <AlertDescription />
  <AlertAction>
    <Button />
  </AlertAction>
</Alert>
```

## Usage

```tsx
"use client";

import { CircleAlert, CircleCheck, Info, Rocket, TriangleAlert } from "lucide-react";
import { Alert, AlertDescription, AlertTitle } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/alert";

export function PrimitiveAlertExample() {
  return (
    <div className="flex w-full max-w-md flex-col gap-3">
      <Alert>
        <Rocket />
        <AlertTitle>Deployment queued</AlertTitle>
        <AlertDescription>Your changes are building and will be live in a few minutes.</AlertDescription>
      </Alert>
      <Alert tone="info">
        <Info />
        <AlertTitle>Scheduled maintenance</AlertTitle>
        <AlertDescription>Builds pause on Sunday from 02:00 to 02:30 UTC.</AlertDescription>
      </Alert>
      <Alert tone="success">
        <CircleCheck />
        <AlertTitle>Domain verified</AlertTitle>
        <AlertDescription>acme.dev now points to your production deployment.</AlertDescription>
      </Alert>
      <Alert tone="warning">
        <TriangleAlert />
        <AlertTitle>Usage at 90%</AlertTitle>
        <AlertDescription>You have 1,200 build minutes left this month.</AlertDescription>
      </Alert>
      <Alert tone="danger">
        <CircleAlert />
        <AlertTitle>Payment failed</AlertTitle>
        <AlertDescription>We couldn't charge your card. Update your billing details to continue.</AlertDescription>
      </Alert>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Anatomy

Scopes, their parts, and the state attributes each part carries. Selector pattern: `[data-skin="{skin}"] :where([data-slot="{part}"][data-control-family="{family}"])`.

- `alert`
  - `action`
  - `description`
  - `root`: `data-tone` (`danger` | `info` | `neutral` | `success` | `warning`)
  - `title`

## Knobs

Registered `--cui-*` custom properties with their recipe defaults. Set them through the component's `style` prop or a skin.

### alert

- `--cui-alert-radius`: `var(--radius-panel)`
- `--cui-alert-background`: `var(--card)`
- `--cui-alert-border-color`: `var(--border)`
- `--cui-alert-shadow`: `none`
- `--cui-alert-foreground`: `var(--card-foreground)`
- `--cui-alert-description-foreground`: `var(--muted-foreground)`
- `--cui-alert-border-width`: `var(--control-rim-width)`
- `--cui-alert-padding`: `calc(var(--spacing) * 3)`
- `--cui-alert-padding-inline`: `calc(var(--spacing) * 4)`
- `--cui-alert-gap`: `calc(var(--spacing) * 0.5)`
- `--cui-alert-icon-gap`: `calc(var(--spacing) * 3)`
- `--cui-alert-icon-size`: `calc(var(--spacing) * 4)`
- `--cui-alert-font-size`: `var(--text-body)`
- `--cui-alert-description-gap`: `var(--spacing)`
- `--cui-alert-title-font-weight`: `var(--font-weight-medium)`
